name: Whispers to the Soul (Mortis, Basic, Path of the Four Humours)

system.description: You can release a wisp of your bilious humour into the ear of a victim, where it will whisper nightmares to him as he sleeps and fearful imaginings when he is awake. While speaking to your victim, whisper his name as you know it and engage in a Social Challenge. If you succeed, he is distracted and edgy and has the Negative Mental Trait Impatient for the remainder of the scene.
